about: Every Form Style setting Flow Tool Kit sets as a CSS custom property on a Form Template, read from the package's style runtime (release 5.3). These are the only --ftk- names a custom component may read. Values exist only where an admin set them (org Form Style defaults, the template's Style Overrides) or a theme sets them (Brand), so every use needs a fallback.

theme_variables.--borderColor: Border color of the template's theme, or of the section's own theme inside a themed section.
theme_variables.--labelColor: Label color of a section theme, inside that section only.
